<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI liquidity and rupee management:</strong> The RBI has injected Rs 1 lakh crore to ease festive season liquidity tightness, even as its ongoing defense of the rupee increases borrowing and operational costs for banks and importers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Fiscal and market outlook:</strong> Markets face pressure from a widening fiscal deficit projected at 6.5% of GDP, with financials leading a recent decline in the Sensex and Nifty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1tQUVaVTZyTFFWa01YQlB4THY2Wm5wS0lDN1l2bDRDNFFLMjdpS2pDLWExcWRkTkZTcEY1YWh2cFkxX1NySXlCdUoxaXRnRWR1c0ZmbWdvY1VYSTdoOXV4S3lrVW9mZUVfM2Q5WV83Y1UxYkozVEVLVg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<ul class="digest-points">
